sheets.noticed: Blueprint-style map with HOME, CAFE, PARK and WORK and numbered edges. Neat, a bit diagrammatic, but the title is clear, so I give it a moment.
Same graph under 'Fastest way home to work'. Still curious, though nothing is moving much.
The graph is static while the narration counts places. Starting to feel like a slide.
Nothing on screen changes except the small caption. Restless, but I keep going one more sheet.
Distance labels turn into infinity markers and HOME lights up with a zero. Some motion, so I stay one more sheet.
The graph is mostly the same and the caption is flat. I would swipe on this stretch.

remembers: A map app works out the fastest way from home to work by comparing the minutes between places, and here the route through the park and the cafe takes eight minutes.
